summary: Build advanced crisis and issues communication plans, messages, and governance. Train your leaders and teams to respond with clarity and control.
lede: Crisis communication gives communications and risk professionals a structured way to identify emerging issues and coordinate responses across channels. For communications and risk professionals responsible for high-stakes organizational narratives, it develops practical skills in scenario mapping, stakeholder-specific holding statements, digital channel coordination, and structured after-action reviews.
audienceIntro: This advanced crisis and issues communication training is tailored for professionals who already carry responsibility for managing high-stakes narratives, supporting leadership during volatile events, and shaping organizational responses to reputational threats.
audience: Chief of Staff or Strategy Lead
modules: Issues Mapping, Sensing, And Early Warning
Holding Statements, Key Messages, And Narrative Control
Digital And Social Media In Crises
After Action Reviews, Metrics, And Executive Reporting
prerequisites: This is an advanced course intended for experienced communication, risk, governance, or public affairs professionals. You are expected to have several years of responsibility for media, stakeholder, or leadership communication, or for managing organizational response to incidents or issues. You should already be comfortable drafting key messages, working with senior leaders, and navigating multi-stakeholder environments. No coding is required. You will work at an operational application and hands-on implementation level for crisis and issues communication tools and frameworks, and at conceptual awareness level for related enterprise risk and analytics concepts. A laptop with access to your usual office productivity tools and browser-based social/digital platforms is strongly recommended for exercises using templates and monitoring simulations.
